files.taskqueue.py:
def sort_tasks(tasks):
    result = []
    for p in sorted({t["priority"] for t in tasks}):
        group = [t for t in tasks if t["priority"] == p]
        dated = sorted(
            (t for t in group if t["due"] is not None),
            key=lambda t: (t["due"], t["title"]),
        )
        undated = sorted(
            (t for t in group if t["due"] is None),
            key=lambda t: t["title"],
        )
        result.extend(dated)
        result.extend(undated)
    return result

validations.evidence: 6 requirements hold
It orders by priority, then dated before undated by due date and title, then undated by title, without mutating the input.
